Peanut Butter Cream Cheese Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 11:32pm

Ingredients




1 cup graham cracker crumbs
1/4 cup brown sugar
2 tablespoons margarine, melted
1/4 cup peanut butter
3 ounces cream cheese
6 tablespoons sugar
1 cup cream, whipped
1 can apple pie filling
1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
1/2 cup powdered sugar
3 tablespoons peanut butter

Preparation

1 Mix together first 4 ingredients; put 1/3 of the mixture in a 6x10-in. 2 Pan. 3 Beat together the cream cheese, sugar and whipped cream. 4 Spoon 1/2 of the cheese mixture over crumbs. Spoon apple pie filling over cheese mixture. Sprinkle cinnamon over apples. 5 Mix together the powdered sugar and peanut butter. 6 Put 2/3 of this mixture over apples. Top with remaining cheese, remaining graham cracker crumbs, and remaining powdered sugar crumbs.
